description: This file defines the NoteViewGridHolder class, a RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying notes in a grid layout in an Android app. It handles binding note data to UI components and manages view properties such as font size and typeface.

classes.name: NoteViewGridHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying notes in a grid view, handling UI binding and interactions.

methods.name: NoteViewGridHolder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with binding and visual settings like font size and monospace option.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException as swipe gestures are not supported in grid view.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to UI components, setting category, status, favorite, and searchable content, and manages view visibility.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Returns null since swipe actions are not supported.
